name: Shioi
source:
A compilation of four different stories based on Japanese fables.

The Crying Red Oni (泣いた赤鬼)
Kachi Kachi Mountain (カチカチ山)
The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter (竹取物語)
Gon the Little Fox (ごんぎつね)
